publishedRecipe.name: Chicken Drumsticks with Spicy Maple-Roasted Cauliflower & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Place chicken in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ½ lb chicken drumsticks
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and golden, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
1 lb white mushrooms
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Place maple syrup, oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and paprika in a large bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp soy sauce
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce
½ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Cut off leaves from the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the sauce.
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Add baking dish to the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the veggies are roasting, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates; top with green onions and enjoy!
